addons.mozilla.org, commonly known as "AMO", is Mozilla's official site for add-ons to Mozilla software, such as Firefox, Thunderbird, and SeaMonkey. Add-ons let you add new features and change the way your browser or application works. Take a look around and explore the thousands of ways to customize the way you do things online.

How are downloads counted?

Download counts are updated every evening and only include original add-on downloads, not updates. Downloads can be broken down by the specific source referring the download.

¿Achike rub'eyal ye'ajiläx ri taq qasanïk?

Ri kajilab'al taq qasanïk chaq'a' ch'aqa' yek'ex xa xe kik'wan ri qitzij taq ruqasaxik ri tz'aqat, manäq ri taq ruk'exoj. Ri taq qasanïk tikirel yejach ruma ri ruxe'el xximo ri qasanïk.

Keep these tips in mind:

  • Write like you're telling a friend about your experience with the add-on. Give specifics and helpful details, such as what features you liked and/or disliked, how easy to use it is, and any disadvantages it has. Avoid generic language such as calling it "Great" or "Bad" unless you can give reasons why you believe this is so.
  • Please do not post bug reports here. We do not make your email address available to add-on developers, so they can't contact you to resolve your issue. See this add-on's support section to find out if assistance is available. You can also try asking the add-on community for help.
  • Please keep reviews clean, avoid the use of improper language and do not post any personal information.

Please read the Review Guidelines for more detail about user add-on reviews.

Tanataj:

  • Katz'ib'an achi'el natzijoj ri awetamab'al chi rij ri tz'aqat chi re jun awachib'il. Ke'acholo' jikïl ri taq rub'anikil, achi'el ri man ütz ta chuqa' ri ütz xatz'ët, we man k'ayew ta nawokisaj chuqa' ri taq ruk'ayewal. Man tawokisaj achi'el ri taq tzij "Ütz" o "Itzel", xa xe we nïm ri aruma.
  • Man taya' kitzijol sachoj wawe'. Man aj winaqil ta ri ataqoya'l ruma ri' toq ri b'anonela' rik'in jub'a' k'o chi yetzijon awik'in. Tatz'eta' rutanaj tob'äl richin nawïl okel to'ïk. Chuqa' yatikïr natojtob'ej nak'utuj rutinamital tz'aqat to'ïk.
  • Tatz'eta' chi e ch'ajch'öj ri taq ejqalem, taq'ata' itzel taq tzij chuqa' man tataluj awetamab'al.

Tasik'ij ri Ketal taq Ejqalem richin ch'aqa' chik kib'anikil kitzijoxik kitz'aqat okisanela'.

What are daily users?

Add-ons downloaded from this site check for updates once per day. The total number of these update pings is known as Active Daily Users. Daily users can be broken down by add-on version, operating system, add-on status, application, and locale.

¿Achike ri q'ij q'ij okisanela'?

Ri taq tz'aqat eqasan rik'in re ruxaq re' nunik'oj we e k'o jun k'exoj pa jun q'ij. Ri kajilab'al re taq qasanïk re' etaman kiwäch achi'el Tzijïl Q'ij Q'ij Okisanela'. Ri q'ij q'ij taq okisanela' yetikïr nikijäch chi ruwäch ri tz'aqat, samajel q'inoj, rub'anikil tz'aqat, chokoy chuqa' ch'ab'äl.

What are daily users?

Themes installed from this site check for updates once per day. The total number of these update pings is known as Active Daily Users, or the total number of people using your theme by day.

¿Achike nuq'ajuj q'ij q'ij okisanela'?

Ri taq wachinel eyakon rik'in re ruxaq re' nunik'oj we e k'o jun k'exoj pa jun q'ij. Ri kajilab'al re taq ruping k'exoj etaman kiwäch achi'el Tzijïl Q'ij Q'ij Okisanela', o ronojel ri winaqi' nikokisaj ri awachinel q'ij q'ij.

Addons.mozilla.org (AMO), is Mozilla's official site for discovering and installing add-ons for the Firefox browser. Add-ons help you modify and personalize your browsing experience by adding new features to Firefox, enhancing your interactions with Web content, and changing the way your browser looks.

%1$s clears your search and browsing history from private tabs when you close them or quit the app. While this doesn’t make you anonymous to websites or your internet service provider, it makes it easier to keep what you do online private from anyone else who uses this device.

%1$s nuyüj ri akanoxik chuqa' runatab'al awokem pa k'amaya'l toq yatel pa ri chokoy o ri ichinan taq wi'. Estape' re re' man yatrewaj ta pan ajk'amaya'l o chuwäch ri niya'on ak'amaya'l, yatruto' richin nichinäx ronojel ri nab'än pan k'amab'ey chuwäch jun chik winäq nrokisaj ri awokisab'al.

%1$s clears your search and browsing history when you quit the app or close all private tabs. While this doesn’t make you anonymous to websites or your internet service provider, it makes it easier to keep what you do online private from anyone else who uses this device.

We believe that large and publicly available voice datasets foster innovation and healthy commercial competition in machine-learning based speech technology. This is a global effort and we invite everyone to participate. Our aim is to help speech technology be more inclusive, reflecting the diversity of voices from around the world.

Niqana'ojij chi ri kiyakb'al kitzij ch'ab'äl ri e nïm chuqa' wachel chi kiwäch winaqi' nutikirisaj ri tz'ukuj chuqa' ri ütz junamaxil k'ayij loq'oj chi kij ri kina'ob'al ch'ab'äl richin kitijoxik ri ch'ich'b'äl. Re re' jun samaj chijun ri ruwach'ulew ruma ri', yixqapeyoj richin kixto'on. Ri qarayib'al ja chi tiqato' ri runa'ob'al ch'ab'äl richin ronojel ke'ok chupam, akuchi' keruk'utu' ri jalajöj taq ch'ab'äl k'o chijun ri ruwach'ulew.

We believe that large, publicly available voice datasets will foster innovation and healthy commercial competition in machine-learning based speech technology.
Common Voice’s multi-language dataset is already the largest publicly available voice dataset of its kind, but it’s not the only one.
Look to this page as a reference hub for other open source voice datasets and, as Common Voice continues to grow, a home for our release updates.

Niqana'ojij chi ri nima'q chuqa' okel taq rucholxe' tzij kuma winaqi' xtunimirisaj ri tz'ukuj chuqa' jun raxinäq junamaxik k'ayij chi kikojol ri runa'ob'al ch'ab'äl, akuchi' pa yonil netamäx.
Ri rucholxe' rutzij k'ïy ch'ab'äl richin ri Common Voice, ja ri' ri janila nïm pa ri ruwäch ri' pa man xa ruyon ta.
Tatz'eta re ruxaq re' achi'el jun runik'ajal ketal ch'aqa' chik taq rucholxe' tzij, jaqäl richin ch'ab'äl, ri Common Voice nik'iyïr chuqa' nik'atzin achi'el ruxe' richin ri kik'exoj ri taq ruwäch.

Adds an option to simulate different color schemes allowing you to test @prefers-color-scheme media queries. Using this media query lets your stylesheet respond to whether the user prefers a light or dark user interface. This feature lets you test your code without having to change settings in your browser (or operating system, if the browser follows a system-wide color scheme setting). See bug 1550804 and bug 1137699 for more details.

Titz'aqatisäx jun cha'oj richin yetojtob'ëx jalajöj taq kichib'enik b'onil, nikiya' q'ij chawe richin ye'atz'ét taq q'ojom @prefers-color-scheme. Ri rokisaxik re samaj re' nuya' q'ij chi ri ruxaq b'anikil tutzolij pe tzij chi rij we ri okisanel nrajo' jun ruk'amal okisanel q'equm o säq ruwa. Re re' nuya' q'ij chawe natojtob'ej ri b'itz'ib' akuchi' man najäl ta ri runuk'ulem okik'amaya'l (o ri rusamajel q'inoj we ri okik'amaya'l nrojqaj jun runuk'ulem ruchib'enik b'onil jikib'an richin chijun ri q'inoj). Tatz'eta' bug 1550804 chuqa' bug 1137699 richin ch'aqa' retal.

An IME (Input Method Editor) is a tool that allows you to enter complex symbols, such as those used in East Asian or Indic written languages, using a standard keyboard. Enabling this experiment will keep the address bar panel open, showing search results and suggestions, while using IME to input text. Note that the IME might display a panel that covers the address bar results, therefore this preference is only suggested for IME not using this type of panel.

Toq nitzij re tojtob'enel xtujäq ri rupas kikajtz'ik taq ochochib'äl, akuchi' yeruk'üt ri e'ilon chuqa' taq chilab'enïk toq nokisäx ri IME richin yetz'ib'äx taq tzij. Tatz'eta' chi ri IME nitikïr nuk'üt jun pas nuq'alajisaj ronojel ri xekanöx pa kikajtz'ik ochochib'äl, ruma ri' nichilab'ëx chi tokisäx re runuk'ulem xa xe we ri IME man nrokisaj ta re ruwäch pas.

Fission (site isolation) is an experimental feature in { -brand-short-name } to provide an additional layer of defense against security bugs. By isolating each site into a separate process, Fission makes it harder for malicious websites to get access to information from other pages you are visiting. This is a major architectural change in { -brand-short-name } and we appreciate you testing and reporting any issues you might encounter. For more details, see the wiki.

Fission (rujech'unik ruxaq) jun tojtob'enel samaj pa richin jun rutz'aqat pisoj richin yeruchajij taq rusachoj jikomal. Toq yerujech'uj jujun ruxaq pa kiyonil, Fission k'ayew nub'än chi ke ri itzel taq ajk'amaya'l ruxaq richin ye'ok pa ketamab'al ch'aqa' chik taq ruxaq ye'atz'ët. Re re' jun nimaläj tz'aqonel jaloj pa { -brand-short-name } chuqa' niqamatyoxij chawe chi natojtob'ej chuqa' naya' rutzijol xab'achike k'ayewal nawïl. %S uses the Mozilla CA store to verify that a connection is secure, rather than certificates supplied by the user’s operating system. So, if an antivirus program or a network is intercepting a connection with a security certificate issued by a CA that is not in the Mozilla CA store, the connection is considered unsafe.

Ruma ri', we jun antivirus o jun k'amb'ey nrojqaj jun okem rik'in jun riqitzijib'al jikomal elesan ruma ri CA, ri man k'o ta ri ruyakb'al CA richin Mozilla xtitz'et chi itzel el okem ri'.

The rel attribute with value "preload" on a <link> element is intended to help provide performance gains by letting you download resources earlier in the page lifecycle, ensuring that they’re available earlier and are less likely to block page rendering. Read “Preloading content with rel="preload"” or see bug 1583604 for more details.

Ri rel b'anikil rik'in rejqalem "preload" pa jun wachinäq link> richin nito'on nutzilaj rub'eyal nisamäj toq nuqasaj taq rutob'al ruxaq, nutz'ët chi k'o chi e k'o richin majun niq'at ri ruwachib'al ruxaq. Tisik'ïx “Rusamajixik chik rupam %MOZ_APP_DISPLAYNAME% ” o titz'et sachoj 1583604 richin rutzijol.

The addition of a constructor to the CSSStyleSheet interface as well as a variety of related changes makes it possible to directly create new stylesheets without having to add the sheet to the HTML. This makes it much easier to create reusable stylesheets for use with Shadow DOM. See bug 1520690 for more details.

Ri rutz'aqatisaxik jun nuk'unel pa ri CSSStyleSheet k'amal achi'el chuqa' juley taq jaloj kik'amon ki' nub'än chi jumul yetz'uk k'ak'a' taq ruxaq rik'in kib'anikil akuchi' man nitz'aqatisäx ta ri HTML ruxaq. Re re' nub'än chi man k'ayew ta yetz'uk kib'anikil ruxaq ri ye'okisäx chik rik'in Shadow DOM. Titz'et bug 1520690 richin ch'aqa' rutzijol.

The Background Update task checks for updates to { -brand-short-name } when { -brand-short-name } is not running. This task is installed automatically by { -brand-short-name }, and is reinstalled when { -brand-short-name } runs. To disable this task, update the browser settings or the { -brand-short-name } enterprise policy setting “BackgroundAppUpdate”.

Re samaj re' niyak pa ruyonil ruma { -brand-short-name } chuqa' niyak chik toq nisamajïx{ -brand-short-name }. Re samaj re' ütz nichup pa runuk'ulem ri okik'amaya'l { -brand-short-name } o pa runuk'ulem runa'ojil ajk'aymoloj “BackgroundAppUpdate”.

The Default Browser Agent task checks when the default changes from { -brand-short-name } to another browser. If the change happens under suspicious circumstances, it will prompt users to change back to { -brand-short-name } no more than two times. This task is installed automatically by { -brand-short-name }, and is reinstalled when { -brand-short-name } updates. To disable this task, update the “default-browser-agent.enabled” preference on the about:config page or the { -brand-short-name } enterprise policy setting “DisableDefaultBrowserAgent”.

Ri rusamaj Rub'anel Okik'amaya'l k'o wi nutz'ët toq ri rejqalem k'o wi nujäl ri' ri { -brand-short-name } rik'in jun chik okik'amaya'l. We nujäl ri' toq k'o jub'a' k'ayewal xtuk'utuj chi re ri okisanel chi tujäl chik rik'in { -brand-short-name } xa kamul. { -brand-short-name } ruyon nuyäk re samaj re' chuqa' nuyäk chik ri' toq nik'extäj ri { -brand-short-name }. Richin nichup re samaj re' tak'exa' ri ajowab'äl “default-browser-agent.enabled” pa ri ruxaq about:config o rirunuk'ulem { -brand-short-name } pa runa'ojil k'ayij “DisableDefaultBrowserAgent”.

The global beforeinput event is fired on an <input> and <textarea> elements, or any element whose contenteditable attribute is enabled, immediately before the element’s value changes. The event allows web apps to override the browser’s default behavior for user interaction, e.g., web apps can cancel user input only for specific characters or can modify pasting styled text only with approved styles.

When rendering the <html> element, the used values of CSS properties “writing-mode”, “direction”, and “text-orientation” on the <html> element are taken from the computed values of the <body> element, not from the <html> element’s own values. Consider setting these properties on the :root CSS pseudo-class. For more information see “The Principal Writing Mode” in https://www.w3.org/TR/css-writing-modes-3/#principal-flow

Tana'ojij nab'än runuk'ulem ri taq ichinil pa ri :root CSS pseudo-class. Richin ch'aqa' chik etamab'äl tab'etz'eta' “The Principal Writing Mode” pa https://www.w3.org/TR/css-writing-modes-3/#principal-flow

A browser is still a tool, so it makes sense that you’ll want to pick the best one for the job. If you’re a human who needs to work to survive, you’ll need a fast internet browser. One thing to keep in mind is a browser that runs third-party trackers is more likely to be slower than a browser that doesn’t. Third-party trackers are cookies, and while you can’t see them, they are running in the background of the site, taking up precious time. The more third-party trackers a browser blocks, the faster it can run.

K'atzinel nitz'et chi toq jun okik'amaya'l nisamäj kik'in kojqanela' aj rox winäq yalan niyoke' chuwäch jun ri man nisamäj ta kik'in. Ri kojqanela' aj rox winäq e kuki, estape' man yatikïr ta ye'atz'ët, yesamäj pa ruka'n k'ojlib'äl pa ri ruxaq k'amaya'l, nreleq'aj aramaj. Toq k'ïy kojqanela' aj rox winäq nuq'ät ri okik'amaya'l, aninäq xtisamäj.

Firefox Health Report (FHR) analyses your browser's performance information, in order to provide you with useful tips that help you get the best from Firefox. For more information on Firefox Health Report, visit the Mozilla Support section.

Rutzijol Raxnaqil Firefox (RRF) yerusöl taq na'oj pa ruwi' rub'eyal nisamäj ri awokik'amaya'l, richin nuq'alajisaj jeb'ël taq pixa' chawe, ri xkatkito' chi nawïl rutzil ri Firefox. Richin nak'ül ch'aqa' chik taq na'oj chi rij ri Rutzijol Raxnaqil Firefox, tab'etz'eta' ri to'onel ruk'ojlib'al Mozilla.

Firefox Health Report (FHR) records anonymous data about your computer, configuration, usage, performance, and error conditions. This data helps us improve Firefox for you and for other Firefox users.

Rutzijol Raxnaqil Firefox (RRF) yerutz'ib'aj kan ri taq man etaman ta kiwäch tzij pa ruwi' rub'anikil akematz'ib', nuk'ulem, rokisaxik, rub'eyal nisamäj chuqa' sachoj. Konojel re taq tzij re' yeto'on pa ruwi' rutzil Firefox richin nawokisaj chuqa' ch'aqa' chik ruwinaq Firefox.
Firefox Health Report lets you know how your Firefox is performing and what you can do to improve it.
Rutzijol Raxnaqil Firefox nuya' q'ij chawe nawetamaj rub'eyal nisamäj ri Firefox awichin chuqa' ri yatikïr nab'än richin nawutzilaj.
Firefox Health Report lets you optimize your Firefox and helps us build a more excellent browser. Reports will be pretty basic at first, but will continue to evolve and grow.

A website data breach happens when cyber criminals steal, copy, or expose personal information from online accounts. It’s usually a result of hackers finding a weak spot in the website’s security. Breaches can also happen when account information gets leaked by accident.

Data aggregators, or data brokers, collect information from public records and buy it from other companies. They compile this data to sell it to companies for marketing purposes. Victims of these breaches are less likely to experience financial fraud, but hackers could use this data to impersonate or profile them.

Your passwords protect more than your accounts. They protect every bit of personal information that resides in them. And hackers rely on bad habits, like using the same password everywhere or using common phrases (p@ssw0rd, anyone?) so that if they hack one account, they can hack many. Here’s how to better protect your accounts.

An Open Norm would give the EU courts the possibility to allow future uses of copyrighted works - uses that may not exist today, but could be crucial tomorrow. This, like fair use, fair dealing and the UGC exception, would be guided by Berne’s “3 Step Test”. For instance, the EU’s existing copyright law was passed in 2001, long before many technological innovations, such as Text and Data Mining (TDM). We didn’t know then that this would be such a useful software to unlock research and innovation. With an Open Norm, courts would have the flexibility to adjust exceptions in EU law (e.g. parody, quotation, panorama, etc) to technological advancements, which would ensure that our new laws remain relevant in 5, 10 or even 15 years.

Jun Jaqäl B'eyal nuya' chi ke ri q'atb'äl rutzij EU q'ij richin nokisäx jun samaj k'o ruch'ojib'al b'anel, rik'in jub'a' ri man k'o ta wakami - po ri yalan rejqalem ri chwa'q kab'ij. Re re', achi'el ri taq man relik ta ütz rokisaxik / ütz k'ulunïk chuqa' ri UGC, nikoqaj ta ri “3 Ruxak Tojtob'enïk” richin Berna. Achi'el ri taqonem rutzij kich'ojib'al b'anel k'o pa EU xjikib'äx pa 2001, toq k'a man etz'eton ta ri k'ïy k'ak'a' samaj taq tz'ukuj, achi'el ri kiya'ab'ajb'al kicholajem tzij chuqa' taq tzij (TDM). Chi ri' k'a man qetaman ta chi nok jun k'atzinel kema' richin ninimirisäx ri rukanoxik na'oj chuqa' ri tz'ukuj. Achi'el jun Jaqäl B'eyal ri q'atb'äl taq tz'ij e jalel ta richin yekiwachib'ej taq man relik ta pa ri taqonem rutzij ri EU (achi'el taq oxk'ob'enïk, rutzijol retal, tz'etoj, ch'aqa' chik) richin nib'iyin ri na'ob'äl, ri nikijikib'a' chi ri taqonem taq qatzij tik'oje' kik'aslem pa ri 5, 10 o chuqa' pa 15 juna'.

Mashups, memes, and GIFs are all examples of modern Internet culture. Copyrighted works are remixed, reimagined, and reused in new and creative ways every day. These elements build on existing ideas in a way that breathes new meaning into old content. Allowing new uses of copyrighted works are needed in order to expand growth and innovation. We need to build into the law flexibility, through a UGC exception and a clause like an open norm, fair dealing, or fair use, to empower everyday people to shape culture and conversations online and keep the Internet awesome.

Mashups, memes chuqa' GIFs e rutz'etb'al ri k'ak'a' b'anob'äl pa k'amaya'l. Ri samaj pa ruwi' kich'ojib'al b'anel, nikixöl ki', yetz'uk chik chuqa' ye'okisäx chik rik'in k'ak'a' chuqa' na'owinaqil taq b'anikil ronojel q'ij. Re taq ch'akulal re' yenuk' pa kiwi' taq na'oj e k'o chik richin nuya' k'ak'a' kiq'ajarik ri ojer taq rupam. Richin niq'alajisäx ri ruk'iyirisanik chuqa' tz'ukuj nik'atzin chi niya' q'ij chi ke k'ak'a' kokisaxik taq samaj rik'in kich'ojib'al b'anel. K'atinel niqaya' rujalel ri taqanem tzij, rik'in jun UGC man relik ta chuqa' rik'in jun mokaj ruk'wan jaqäl b'eyal, ütz k'uluj o ütz rokisaxik richin chi konojel tikinuk'u' b'anob'äl chuqa' taq tzijonem pa k'amb'ey chuqa' tikib'ana' chi ri K'amaya'l junelïk jeb'ël tiwachin.
Mass Surveillance is a threat to privacy and trust online. Our community fought for the successful passage of the USA FREEDOM Act, a first step toward reforming mass surveillance.

These types of exemptions allow people to make use of copyrighted works for the purpose of education, remix, parody, criticism, or quotation. As long as their use does not interfere with the “regular economic exploitation” of the work, and does not unreasonably prejudice the interests of the copyright owner (for instance, making Game of Thrones memes would be allowed, but downloading the episodes on the Pirate Bay still not allowed). This ‘test’ is established in international copyright law, called the “Berne Convention’s Three Step Test”. Many countries already have a fair use / fair dealing clause in their laws, including Canada, the United States, Australia, India, and the United Kingdom. In general, a “fair use” clause is much more broad than a “fair dealing” clause, however both can be very useful in creating flexibility to allow access to, and/or creative transformations of copyrighted works. It’s time that the EU introduce such an exception to allow new and innovative uses of copyrighted works to breathe new life into old content.

A browser is still a tool, so it makes sense that you’ll want to pick the best one for the job. If you’re a human who needs to work to survive, you’ll need a fast internet browser. One thing to keep in mind is a browser that runs third-party trackers is more likely to be slower than a browser that doesn’t. Third-party trackers are cookies, and while you can’t see them, they are running in the background of the site, taking up precious time. The more third-party trackers a browser blocks, the faster it can run.

An ad blocker is a piece of software that can be used to block ads, and they work in two ways. The first way is when an ad blocker blocks the signal from an advertiser’s server, so the ad never shows up on your page. Another way ad blockers work is by blocking out sections of a website that could be ads.

An internet with these qualities will not come to life on its own. Individuals and organizations must embed these aspirations into internet technology and into the human experience with the internet. The Mozilla Manifesto and Addendum represent Mozilla’s commitment to advancing these aspirations. We aim to work together with people and organizations everywhere who share these goals to make the internet an even better place for everyone.

Another browser feature that should be a given is the ability to prevent websites and companies from tracking your browsing and shopping data — even in normal browsing mode. But that’s actually not the case: in fact, the only browsers that block third party tracking cookies by default are Firefox and Safari.

Xa xe chi man ke ri' ta, ri taq okik'amaya'l kan yekiq'ät ri taq kikuki aj rox winäq ja ri Firefox chuqa' ri Safari.
Another way to stop trackers from tracking is using private mode to browse. Any browser that claims to be private should offer browsing in private mode.

Based on the criteria we outlined — privacy, utility, and portability — there’s really only one browser that meets the mark, and that’s Firefox. The real area of difference isn’t in functionality, it’s privacy. Firefox is the most private browser that doesn’t lock you into an ecosystem. Use it on any operating system, on all your devices, and feel secure when you do.

Firefox is offering something new to keep you safe: Firefox Monitor. It’s a free service that will alert you if there are any public hacks on your accounts and let you know if your accounts got hacked in the past. Another neat feature is the Green Lock. It looks like a small green icon at the top left side of the browser window. If you’re on Firefox and see the green lock, it means the website is encrypted and secure. If the lock is grey, you might want to think twice about entering any sensitive information.

Mozilla doesn’t know as much as you’d expect about how people browse the web. As a browser maker, that’s actually a big challenge for us. That is why we’ve built opt-in tools, such as Firefox Pioneer, which allows interested users to give us insight into their web browsing. If you sync your browsing history across Firefox installations, we don’t know what that history is - because it’s encrypted by your device.

Mozilla is not your average organization. Founded as a community open source project in 1998, Mozilla is a mission-driven organization working towards a more healthy internet. The majority of Mozilla Corporation’s revenue is from royalties earned through Firefox web browser search partnerships and distribution deals around the world. You can learn more about how we make money in our annual financial report.

Since your browser is your gateway to the internet, speed, security, privacy and utility are paramount. In recent years, Google Chrome has been the browser of choice for many. But at a time when online ads seem to follow us everywhere and data breaches are a fixture of news headlines, a lot of people are starting to demand more privacy and respect from their browser.

Xa ja ri okik'amaya'l ruchi' jay richin yatok pa k'amaya'l, ri aninem, ri jikomal, ri ichinanem chuqa' ri nach'äk yalan e k'atzinel. Re ruk'isib'äl taq juna', Google Chrome jun okik'amaya'l yalan kicha'on. Xa xe chi toq ri taq eltzijol pa k'amab'ey achi'el yojkojqaj xab'akuchi' chuqa' ri eläq' taq tzij yalan k'o kitzijol pa taq rutzijol, k'ïy winaqi' nikik'utuj k'ïy ichinanem chuqa' chi ri okik'amaya'l kerukamelaj.

The first thing to point out about portability is that not all browsers run on all operating systems. While Firefox, Chrome and Opera work on all major systems and are easy to install, Internet Explorer, Edge and Safari only work on Microsoft and Apple’s own systems. The mobile version of Safari is pre-installed on Apple’s mobile devices, and most Android devices come with a pre-installed browser modified by the manufacturer for the device. Firefox, Chrome, Edge and Opera can easily be installed and even used side by side.

The second is what we call "interaction data." This is data about an individual's engagement with Firefox, such as the number of tabs that were open, the status of user preferences, or number of times certain browser features were used, such as screenshots or containers. For example, we collect this data in terms of the back button, that arrow in the upper left corner of your browser that lets you navigate back to a previous webpage in a way that shows us someone used the back button, but doesn’t tell what specific webpages are accessed.

Using a browser that blocks third-party trackers isn’t just important for privacy — it usually means it runs much faster, too. Most trackers are just scripts that run in the background on a number of websites. You can’t see them, but you can feel them slowing down your browser. As of version 67 of Firefox, fingerprinting and cryptominers are also blocked. If you’re not familiar with cryptominers, here’s an example of how they can affect you: maybe you’ve experienced your computer suddenly running hotter or the battery depleting faster than normal. That’s often the byproduct of cryptominers creeping around on your device.

Rik'in ri ruwäch 67 Firefox ri kanonela' retal q'ab'aj chuqa' ri taq ajkriptom chuqa' eq'aton. A browser is still a tool, so it makes sense that you’ll want to pick the best one for the job. If you’re a human who needs to work to survive, you’ll need a fast internet browser. One thing to keep in mind is a browser that runs third-party trackers is more likely to be slower than a browser that doesn’t. Third-party trackers are cookies, and while you can’t see them, they are running in the background of the site, taking up precious time. The more third-party trackers a browser blocks, the faster it can run.

Using a browser that blocks third-party trackers isn’t just important for privacy — it usually means it runs much faster, too. Most trackers are just scripts that run in the background on a number of websites. You can’t see them, but you can feel them slowing down your browser. As of version 67 of { -brand-name-firefox }, fingerprinting and cryptominers are also blocked. If you’re not familiar with cryptominers, here’s an example of how they can affect you: maybe you’ve experienced your computer suddenly running hotter or the battery depleting faster than normal. That’s often the byproduct of cryptominers creeping around on your device.

Mozillians are people who volunteer their time to advance the Mozilla mission. They're dedicated to promoting openness, innovation and opportunity on the Web and they form the core of our community.

This directory is a resource to make it easy for Mozillians to learn who is involved, what they do and how to connect with them. It also allows you to receive email communications from Mozilla.

These features, and others, are currently in development. If you'd like to help us out with these, find out how you can get involved.

Ri aj Mozilla e winaqi' nikiya' kiramaj richin nib'iyin ri taqel rutaqanem Mozilla. Ri rurayb'al richin nuyäk ruk'u'x ri tz'ukuj, jalatajinem chuqa' ri samaj pa Ajk'amaya'l chuqa' nunük' ri ruk'u'x qatinamit.

Re cholb'äl re' jun tob'äl richin man k'ayew ta nub'än chi kiwäch ri aj Mozilla niketamaj kiwäch ri tajin yeto'on, achike nikib'än chuqa' achike rub'eyal yojtzijon kik'in. Chuqa' nuya' q'ij chawe nak'ül taq tzijol pa k'amaya'l richin Mozilla.

Re taq b'anikil re', chuqa' k'o ch'aqa' chik tajin yenuk'. We nawajo' yojato', tawila' achike rub'eyal yatikïr kato'on.

Mozillians are people who volunteer their time to advance the Mozilla mission. They're dedicated to promoting openness, innovation and opportunity on the Web and they form the core of our community.

This directory is a resource to make it easy for Mozillians to learn who is involved, what they do and how to connect with them. It also allows you to receive email communications from Mozilla.

Want to find Mozillians in Auckland for a meetup? Need an expert XPCOM hacker to review a patch? That's exactly what this site is for.

These features, and others, are currently in development. If you'd like to help us out with these, find out how you can get involved.

Re cholb'äl re' jun tob'äl richin man k'ayew ta nub'än chi kiwäch ri aj Mozilla niketamaj kiwäch ri tajin yeto'on, achike nikib'än chuqa' achike rub'eyal yojtzijon kik'in.

¿La nawajo' ye'awïl aj Mozilla pan Auckland richin jun moloj? ¿La nawajo' jun utziläj chi jaker pa XPCOM richin nunik'oj jun k'ojoj? Ja ri' nik'atzin re ruxaq k'amaya'l re'.

Re taq b'anikil re', chuqa' k'o ch'aqa' chik tajin yenuk'. We nawajo' yojato', tawila' achike rub'eyal yatikïr kato'on.

Cliqz GmbH collects data about your search and browsing activity, including text as you type in the URL bar, queries you send to certain search engines, and data about your web page interactions, such as mouse movements, scrolls, and time spent.

Cliqz GmbH yerumöl taq tzij chi rij ri awokem pa k'amaya'l chuqa' taq akanoxik, achi'el chuqa' ri natz'ib'aj pa ri kikajtz'ik ochochib'äl, taq k'utunïk ye'atäq chi ke jujun k'wab'äl taq kanob'äl chuqa' etamab'äl pa ruwi' rub'eyal yasamäj pa ri taq ruxaq ajk'amaya'l, achi'el ri rusilonem ch'oy chuqa' ri ramaj naya' chi ke.

Cliqz GmbH collects telemetry analytics, including your interactions with specific fields and buttons in Cliqz. This data is tied to a unique identifier allowing Cliqz GmbH to understand performance over time.

Cliqz GmbH yerumöl taq runa'ojel telemetry, achi'el chuqa' ri rub'eyal yasamäj kik'in jikïl taq k'ojlib'äl chuqa' taq rupitz'b'al Cliqz. Re etamab'äl re' toq ruximon ri' rik'in jun ruyonil k'utüy, nuya' q'ij chi re ri Cliqz GmbH nino' pa ruwi' ri rub'eyal nisamäj.

Containers let you create profiles in Firefox for all of your online lives. Custom labels and color-coded tabs help keep different activities — like online shopping, travel planning, or checking work email — separate. Because Containers store cookies separately, you can log into the same site with a different account in each Container, and online trackers can’t connect your browsing in one container to another. So you can keep your shopping self separate from your social self from your work self, without worrying about being followed around the Web.

Ri taq k'ojlib'äl nikiya' q'ij chawe richin ye'atz'ük taq ruwäch b'i'aj pa Firefox richin jujun taq rupam ak'aslem pa k'amab'ey. Ri ichinan taq etal chuqa' kib'itz'ib' b'onil nikiya' q'ij chawe' naya' kikojol chuqa' ye'ajäch ri taq samaj — taq loq'oj, runuk'samaj b'eyajem o ri rutaqoya'l samaj. Ri taq k'ojlib'äl yekiyäk taq kaxlanwey pa jachon rub'eyal, yatikïr yatok pa ri ruxaq ri' rik'in jun junwi chi rub'i' taqoya'l chi jujun k'ojlib'äl, ke ri' ri ojqanela' man xketikïr ta xtikixïm ri awokem pa jun k'ojlib'äl rik'in jun chik. Get back to browsing without losing your stream of thought. Activity Stream keeps your top sites, bookmarks and recent history close at hand in each new tab. And the new timeline view gives you a birds-eye view of your browsing.

Love multitasking? Try Min Vid. It’s like picture-in-picture where one picture is a media player and the other is the entire Web.

  • Click and go: Pop up the Min Vid frame to keep videos playing in the foreground while you browse.
  • Put it where you want it: Min Vid lets you drag the video frame anywhere on your desktop.
  • Controls where you need them: Min Vid includes controls to let you pause/play, scrub, drag, minimize, and adjust volume right in the frame.
  • Now supporting audio playback: Min Vid now supports playback from SoundCloud and direct mp3 links.
  • Create a queue: Min Vid now supports queues, just start up a video and add tracks from any supported domains (YouTube, Vimeo, SoundCloud, and direct links).
  • View your history: Min Vid keeps track of your history, just pop open the queue panel from the top right of the player and you can access all the media you've been playing.

¿La niqa chawäch nab'än jalajöj taq samaj? Tatojtob'ej Min Vid. Achi'el jun wachib'äl pa jun chik wachib'äl, akuchi' jun wachib'äl xa jun q'axab'äl k'oxom, ja k'a ri jun chik ja ronojel ri Ajk'amaya'l.

  • Tapitz'a' richin natikirisaj: Taqaja' ri Min Vid richin chi ri silowäch titzijtäj nab'ey toq yatok pa k'amaya'l.
  • Taya' apo akuchi' nawajo': Min Vid nuya' q'ij chawe naqirirej ri rutzuwäch silowäch pa xab'akuchi' ruk'ojlib'al ajk'amaya'l.
  • Ri taq samajinel xab'akuchi' nawajo' rat: Ri Min Vid k'o taq rusamajinel ri nikiya' q'ij chawe richin naq'ät/natzïj, naqirirej ri rujolom tzijonïk, nach'utinisaj chuqa' nacha' ri rupalem ruch'ab'äl.
  • Tatz'uku' rucholajem tzijonem: Wakami ri Min Vid nuköch' tzijonem richin SoundCloud chuqa' choj taq ruximonel mp3.
  • Tatz'uk' rucholajem tzijonem: Wakami ri Min Vid nuköch rucholaj tzijonem, xa xe titzija' jun silowäch chuqa' tatz'aqatisaj jun retal k'oxom pa jun koch'el samajib'äl (Youtube, Vimeo, SoundCloud, chuqa' choj taq ximonel).
  • Tatz'eta' anatab'al: Ri Min Vid nuk'öl rucholajem anatab'al, xa xe tajaqa' ri kipas taq rucholajem tzijonem pan ajsik rajkiq'a' q'ajab'äl richin yatok pa ronojel ri e'atzijon.
Popular sites, people and Wikipedia articles appear as you type.
Toq yatz'ib'an yeb'ewachin pe taq ruxaq k'amaya'l, winaqi' chuqa' taq rucholna'oj Wikipedia.

Page Shot lets you take, share, and retrieve screenshots - without leaving Firefox.

  • Grid view: Browse thumbnails of saved screenshots
  • Smart search: Find the screenshot you're looking for with just a keyword. Page Shot indexes page titles and text in screenshots
  • One-step sharing: Post your screenshot to social media or copy the shareable link right from the top of your browser window.

Ri Page Shot nuya' q'ij chawe richin nachäp ruwäch, ye'akomonij chuqa' ye'aköl, akuchi' man k'atzinel ta yatel el pa Firefox.

  • Rutz'etb'al k'ïy kajtz'ik:Ke'anachaj ri taq chapoj eyakon
  • Na'owinäq taq kanoxïk: Tawila' ri chapoj tajin nakanoj rik'in jun ruk'u'x tzij. Page Shot nuchola yerucholajij ri taq rub'i' ruxaq chuqa' ri rucholajem kitzij ri taq chapoj
  • Tikomonïx rik'in jun pitz'oj: Tataqa' ri achapoj pa ri aj winäq k'amab'ey o tawachib'ej jun ximonel richin nikomonïx pa rutzuwäch awokik'amaya'l.
Provide feedback about website performance as you browse.
Tataqa' etamab'äl chi rij ri rub'eyal nisamäj ri ruxaq toq atokinäq pa k'amaya'l.

Send lets you upload and encrypt large files (up to 1GB) to share online. When you upload a file, Send creates a link to pass along to whoever you want. Each link created by Send will expire after 1 download or 24 hours, and all sent files will be automatically deleted from the Send server.

Unlike other Test Pilot experiments, Send does not require an add-on, and can be used in any modern browser.

Ri Send nuya' q'ij chawe najotob'a' chuqa' nawewaj kisik'ixik nima'q taq yakb'äl (k'a 1 GB) richin nakomonij pa kamab'ey. Toq najotob'a' jun yakb'äl, ri Send nutz'ük jun ximonel richin natäq xab'achoj chi re nawajo'. Nik'is ruq'ijul jun ximonel ri nutz'ük ri Send toq niqasäx o toq nik'o 24 ramaj, chuqa' konojel ri taq yakb'äl xetaq pa ruyonil xkeyujtäj el pa ruk'u'x rusamaj ri Send.

Jun rukojol kik'in ch'aqa' chik taq rusolna'oj Test Pilot, ri Send man nik'atzin ta jun chokoy chi re ruma ri' tikirel nokisäx pa xab'achike k'ak'a' okik'amaya'l.

Take your passwords everywhere with Firefox Lockbox. This Test Pilot experiment gives you access to all the logins you've saved to Firefox, in a secure app on your iPhone. Just log in to Lockbox with your Firefox Account, and your saved usernames and passwords will sync to the app using 256-bit encryption. So you’ll have easy access to online accounts, even on the go.

Firefox Lockbox requires a Firefox Account in order to access your previously saved logins. If you do not have an account set up, get started here.

Want to be notified when our Android app launches? Sign up here.

Please note, Firefox Lockbox is currently an English only app available in a few regions including Australia, New Zealand, United Kingdom, United States, and Canada.

Ke'ak'waj ri ewan taq atzij xab'akuchi' rik'in Firefox Lockbox. Re rutojtob'enel Test Pilot re' nuya' q'ij chawe yatok pa ronojel tikirib'äl molojri'ïl e'ayakon kan pa Firefox, pa jun jikïl ruchokoy awiPhone. Xa xe yatok pa Lockbox rik'in ri ataqoya'l richin Firefox chuqa' ri ab'i' richin okisanel chuqa' ewan taq atzij e'ayakon, xtikixïm ki' rik'in ri chokoy rik'in ri 256 bit ewan rusik'ixik. Anin xkatok pa ri rub'i' ataqoya'l pa k'amab'ey, ke ri' chuqa' rik'in ri ab'inem.

Firefox Lockbox nrajo' jun rub'i' rutaqoya'l Firefox richin nok pa ri tikirib'äl amolojri'ïl ri eyakon kan saved logins. We man b'anon ta runuk'ulem jun rub'i' ataqoya'l, tatikirisaj qa wawe'.

¿La nawajo' chi niqaya' rutzijol chawe toq xtiqelesaj pe ri qachokoy richin Android? Tatz'ib'aj awi' wawe'.

Tatz'eta' chi ri Firefox Lockbox jun chokoy xa xe wachel pa q'anchi' pa jujun taq k'ojlib'äl, achi'el chuqa' pan Australia, Nueva Zelanda, Reino Unido, Estados Unidos chuqa' Canadá.
Take your tabs from in the way to tucked away. Tab Center moves your tabs to the side of your browser window so they're out of sight when you don't need them, and easy to expand and grab when you do.
Ke'awewaj ri taq ruwi'. Tab Center yerusiloj ri taq ruwi' chuxikin rutzuwäch okik'amaya'l, akuchi' yerewaj toq man yek'atzin ta chawe, po chanin e'okel toq yeb'ek'atzin pe chawe.
This one is simple. If you hit a 404 page while browsing the web, we will let you know if the content you're looking for is archived on the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine.
Re re' choj relik. We nawïl jun sachoj 404 toq atokinäq pa ajk'amaya'l, xtiqaya' rutzijol chawe we ri rupam yakon pa ri Internet Archive's Wayback Machine.
To report a site that doesn't work with Pulse, select the Pulse icon in the bar that displays the URL of the site.
Richin niya' rutzijol jun ruxaq ri man nuk'äm ta ri' rik'in ri Pulse, tacha' ri ruwachaj Pulse, ri k'o pa rucholajem ri URL richin ri ruxaq.
To report a site that doesn't work with Tracking Protection, select the shield icon in the bar that displays the URL of the site.
Richin niya' rutzijol jun ruxaq ri man nusamäj ta ütz rik'in ri Chajinïk chuwäch Ojqanem, tacha' ri ruwachaj b'oko' pa URL richin ri ruxaq.
Pulse may also prompt you at random to rate a website.
Rik'in jub'a' ri Pulse xtuk'utuj chawe chi taya' rajil jun jalwachinel ruxaq ajk'amaya'l.
Pulse may prompt you to answer a short survey about your experience on a website.
Rik'in jub'a' ri Pulse xtuk'utuj chawe chi tanojisaj jun ko'öl nojwuj pa ruwi' awetamab'al rik'in jun ruxaq ajk'amaya'l.
Pulse will only send information to us when you interact with it, such as submitting a survey, or when you are prompted to do so.
Ri Pulse xa xe xtutäq etamab'äl chi qe achi'el toq xtanojisaj jun nojwuj o nik'utüx chawe chi tataqa' etamab'äl.
Pulse will send information about the page you are viewing when you submit a survey, such as the hostname and domain of the page, and the network requests associated with the page.
Ri Pulse xtutäq etamab'äl chi rij ri ruxaq xatz'ët toq xanojisaj jun nojwuj, achi'el ri rub'i' ruk'u'x samaj chuqa' ri ruk'ojlem rub'ey ruxaq chuqa' ri taq ruk'utunik k'amab'ey kiximon ki' rik'in.

Pulse will send information about your browser and your device, such as what operating system and version of Firefox you are running, what addons and settings you have enabled, and how many tabs you have open.

Ri Pulse xtutäq etamab'äl chi rij ri awokik'amaya'l chuqa' awokisaxel, achi'el ri samajel q'inoj chuqa' ri ruwäch Firefox tajin nawokisaj, ri taq chokoy chuqa' taq cha'oj xe'atzïj chuqa' jarupe' taq ruwi' e'ajaqon.

Until now, Tracking Protection in Firefox was only available in Private Browsing mode. This experiment enables Tracking Protection all the time! (Of course, you can disable it on a site-by-site basis whenever you want.)

This experiment lets you help us understand where Tracking Protection breaks the Web so that we can improve it for all Firefox users. As you browse, click the purple shield icon in the URL bar at the top of the page to tell us which sites work well with Tracking Protection and which don't.

K'a wakami, ri Chajinïk chuwäch Ojqanem pa Firefox xa xe k'o pa Ichinan Okem pa K'amaya'l. ¡Re solna'oj re' jantape' rutzijon! (Yatikïr nachüp chi kikojol taq ruxaq toq nawajo'.)

Re solna'oj re' nuya' q'ij chawe richin yojato' chi niq'ax pan qawi' akuchi' man nisamäj ta ri Chajinïk chuwäch Ojqanem, ke ri' nib'an rutzil chi kiwäch konojel ri ruwinaq Firefox. Toq atokinäq pa k'amaya'l, tapitz'a' ri ruwachaj ri tuq' b'oko', pa ri rukajtz'ik URL ajsik ruxaq richin nab'ij chi qe achike ruxaq yesamäj ütz rik'in ri Chajinïk chuwäch Ojqanem chuqa' ri manäq.

Voice Fill uses artificial intelligence to interpret speech input. As a participant in the Voice Fill experiment, your voice searches will teach our AI to provide smarter results.

We’ve added Voice Fill to Google, Yahoo and DuckDuckGo search pages, and will expand to more sites as the experiment progresses.

Voice Fill nrokisaj tz'ukun na'oj richin nisol ri runimik tzij. Achi'el to'onel pa ri rusolna'oj Voice Fill, ri rukanoxik atzij xtuk'üt chuwäch ri AI richin yeruya' pe na'owinäq taq q'i'oj.

Xqatz'aqatisaj Voice Fill pa taq ruxaq kanoxïk pa Google, Yahoo chuqa' DuckDuckGo chuqa' xketz'aqatisäx pa ch'aqa' chik taq ruxaq k'amaya'l toq xtib'iyin ri solna'oj.
Rate your experience and answer a few questions.
Taya' rajil ri awetamab'al chuqa' tatzolij kitzij re jub'a' taq k'utunïk re'.
Ready to try a new Test Pilot experiment? Select one to enable, take it for a spin, and let us know what you think.

Recommendations for popular sites and Wikipedia articles will appear as you type.
Toq yatz'ib'an, xkeb'ewachin pe taq kichilab'enik ruxaq k'amaya'l chuqa' taq rucholna'oj Wikipedia.
Redecorate and move the furniture! Tab Center works with your favorite Firefox themes.
¡Tawachib'ej chik chuqa' tanuk'u' achi'el nawajo'! Tab Center nisamäj kik'in ri jeb'ël taq ruwachinik pa Firefox.
Reduce 404 dead ends with the Wayback Machine.
Ke'ch'utinisaj ri tz'apin taq ruq'a' rub'ey 404 rik'in Wayback Machine.
Report a problem and help us troubleshoot.
Taya' rutzijol jun k'ayewal richin yojato' richin niqab'än rutzil.
Return to your favorite sites in one click when you open a new tab. You can even customize your favorites.
Katzolin pa ri ajowanel taq ruxaq ak'amaya'l toq napïtz richin najäq jun k'ak'a' ruwi'. Chuqa' yatikïr ye'awichinaj ri taq ajowanel.
Right click on links to media to find Min Vid in the in-context controls.
Tapitz'a' rajkiq'a' ch'oy chi rij ri ruximonel k'ïy k'oxom richin yatok pa ri taq rusamajel rokem Min Vid.
Right website, wrong time? Snooze it until you need it. Snooze Tabs let you dismiss tabs now and set an alarm to open them later.

¿La ütz chi ajk'amaya'l ruxaq po man pa ri ramaj ta? Yatikïr nayokob'a' kan k'a nik'atzin na pe chawe. Snooze Tabs nuya' q'ij chawe ye'awelesaj kan taq ruwi' wakami chuqa' nanuk'ub'ej kan jun k'asöy richin najäq jub'a' chik na.
Say bye-bye to your tab until...
Tab'ij yojch'o chik chi re ri ruwi' k'a...
Search or browse to find saved screenshots.
Tikanöx o tok pa k'amaya'l richin yekanöx taq chapoj ruwa eyakon kan.
See real time summary information - like weather - right below the URL bar.
Titz'et etamab'äl chi rij q'ijul - achi'el ri meq'tewal - chuxe' rukajtz'ik URL.
See where the web takes you. Advance notes the webpage you’re on and recommends the next thing you’ll want to read.
Tatz'eta' akuchi' yaruk'waj ri ajk'amaya'l. Advance nuya' retal ri ajk'amaya'l ruxaq natz'ët chuqa' nuchilab'ej chawe ri jun chik nawajo' nasik'ij.
See where you've been, so you can get on to where you're going.
Tatz'eta' akuchi' atik'owinäq pe richin nawetamaj akuchi' yab'e.
Select from categories like Shopping, Finance, and Work or create custom labels that work for you.
Ke'acha' taq ruwäch achi'el Taq Loq'oj, Taq Ajpwäq chuqa' Samaj chuqa' yatikïr ye'atz'ük ichinan taq etal ri nuk'äm ri' awik'in.

Tacha' ri wachaj richin nawokisaj qa Min Vid.
Select the icon to start using Page Shot.
Ticha' ri wachaj richin nokisäx qa ri Page Shot.

Tacha' ri ruwa wachib'äl chuqa' we nawajo', tayaka' qa, we mani, taq'ata' richin man niyak ta qa.

Tacha' toq nawajo' chi nib'ewachin chik pe.
Send 1.1.0 just shipped with enhanced browser support and a few other improvements as well.
K'a b'a' titaq Send 1.1.0 rik'in jeb'ël ruto'ik okik'amaya'l chuqa' ch'aqa' chik jujun taq rutzil.
Send is also subject to our websites privacy notice. When you visit the Send website, information such as your IP address is temporarily retained as part of a standard server log.

Ri Send chuqa' rojqan ri rutzijol richinanem ajk'amaya'l ruxaq. Toq natz'ët ri ajk'amaya'l ruxaq ri Send, etamab'äl achi'el ri IP awochochib'al niwachin achi'el jun peraj chi re jun rutz'ib'anik pa rub'eyal ruk'u'x samaj.
Send lets you upload and share encrypted files.
Ri Send nuya' q'ij chawe richin ye'ajotob'a' chuqa' ye'akomonij ewan rusik'isik taq yakb'äl.

Send will also collect information about the performance and your use of the service, such as how often you upload files, how long your files remain with Mozilla before they expire, any errors related to file transfers, and what cryptographic protocols your browser supports.

Ri Send chuqa' xtumöl etamab'äl chi rij rub'eyal nisamäj chuqa' rokisaxik ri samaj, achi'el jarupe' mul ye'ajotob'a' taq yakb'äl, jarupe' ramaj nik'oje' pa Mozilla chuwäch nik'o ruq'ijul, xab'achike sachoj chi rij kiq'axik taq yakb'äl chuqa' ri chib'äl rub'eyal taq samaj ri nuk'ül ri okik'amaya'l.
Send will only store your files for one download or 24 hours.
Ri Send xa xe yeruyäk ri taq ayakb'al k'a toq xke'aqasaj o xa xe 24 ramaj.

Senior Crawl Engineer, The Internet Archive
Share links to images via social or email, without having to download and attach a file.

Ri SMS samaj xa xe okel pa jujun taq amaq'. Rik'in jub'a' nisamajïx kajil ri SMS o taq tzij. Ri nik'ulu ri taqoya'l o ri SMS k'o chi nikochin. { $learnMore }
Snooze Tabs does NOT collect any information or details about your tabs such as URLs, meta attributes, or page content.
Ri Snooze Tabs man numöl ta etamab'äl o taq kitzijoxkil taq ruwi', achi'el URLs, taq ichintzijoxkil, o kipan taq ruxaq.

Snooze Tabs help you focus your attention online, whether you want to remove distractions for now or save something for later. Hit the snooze icon to dismiss tabs you don’t want now, and set an alarm to bring them back when you need them. Snooze an interesting article until tonight. Snooze that recipe until next month. When the snooze is ended, the tab will open back up.

Snooze Tabs yatruto' chi k'o awäch pa k'amab'ey, richin yeruyüj ri nikik'äm awäch achi'el chuqa'richin nayäk kan jun wachinäq jub'a' chik na. Tapitz'a' pa ri wachaj richin ye'ajech'ej kan taq ruwi' ri man ye'awajo' ta wakami, chuqa' taya' kan jun k'asöy richin ye'atzolij pe toq ye'awajo'. Yatikïr nayokob'a' kan jun jeb'ël cholna'oj richin chaq'a'. Nayokob'a' kan ri rutzijol q'utu'n k'a ri jun chik ik'. Toq xtapon ri ruq'ijul nuk'un kan, xtijaqatäj chik ri ruwi'.
Snooze Tabs will also collect information about your use of the feature, such as when you create a new Snoozed tab, wake or close a Snoozed tab, or focus a Snoozed tab.
Snooze Tabs xtumöl etamab'äl chi rij kokisaxik taq ruwi' etanab'an, achi'el toq xtitanab'äx jun k'ak'a' ruwi', ye'atz'apij, ye'atzolij o nuk'ül ri tzub'al.
Snooze Tabs will collect information about your interactions with the add-on, such as when you open the Snooze panel from the toolbar button, and access, edit or delete Snoozed tabs within the panel.
Snooze Tabs xtumöl etamab'äl chi rij ri nab'än rik'in ri chokoy, achi'el toq najáq ri pas pa ri pitz'b'äl pa kikajtz'ik samajib'äl o we yatok, nanük' o nayüj ri ruwi' tanab'an.
Snooze Tabs will notify you when your tab returns.
Snooze Tabs xtuya' rutzijol chawe toq xtijaqatäj chik ri ruwi'.
Snooze Tabs will soon be available as an add-on for all Firefox users. If you have the experiment installed, you will be updated automatically.
Nipe yan, Snooze Tabs xtiwachin achi'el tz'aqat kichin rokisanela' Firefox. We ayakon, ruyonil xtuk'exela' ri'.

Katz'ib'an qa pa kikajtz'ik taq ochochib'äl richin ye'atz'ët jujik ri ye'awïl.

Take as many notes as you like and stay in sync with your Firefox Account.

Tell us when things work and when they don't.

To allow you to see the status of your previously uploaded files, or delete them, basic information about your uploaded files are stored on your local device, such as Send’s identifier for the file, the filename, and the file’s unique download link. This is cleared if you delete your uploaded file or upon visiting Send after the file expires.

Richin natz'ët ri kib'anikil taq yakb'äl e'ajotob'an, o richin ye'ayüj el, pa ri aj wawe' okisaxel niyak ruxe'el etamab'äl chi kij ri taq yakb'äl xejotob'äx, achi'el ri ya'öy retal taqonïk, rub'i' yakb'äl chuqa' ri yonil ximonel richin niqasäx. Ronojel re etamab'äl re' xtiyuj el we nelesäx el ri yakb'äl o we nab'etz'eta' ri Send toq xik'o yan ruq'ijul ri yakb'äl.

To help us improve the accuracy of our suggestions, we may retain a copy of submitted audio recordings, and related suggestion information. Audio recordings kept for this purpose will not be associated with any other personal identifiers.

Richin yojato' richin ütz rub'anikil kisamajixik taq qachilab'enik, rik'in jub'a' k'o chi nik'oje' pa qaq'a' jun kiwachib'al ri taq kiyakoj q'ojom etaqon chuqa' ri etamab'äl chilab'enïk ruximon ri' rik'in. Ri yakoj taq q'ojom eyakon richin re rayb'äl re', man xtixim ta rik'in majun chi winäq k'utunel.
To identify trackers, we use a list provided by our partner Disconnect. You can read more about the standards Disconnect applies here.
Richin niya' ketal ri ojqanela', niqokisaj jun cholb'äl nuya' ri Disconnect. Yatikïr nawïl ch'aqa' chik taq rub'eyal nrokisaj ri Disconnect wawe'.
To opt out of email updates, simply click the unsubscribe link on any Test Pilot email.
Richin yek'ul taq k'exoj pa taqoya'l, tapitz'a' pa ruwi' ri ximonel unsubscribe pa xab'achike rutaqoya'l Test Pilot.
To prevent abuse of this service, we do basic security monitoring. For example, we collect and retain IP addresses to detect and block individuals who are scanning the service to find private pages.

Richin nichajïx rutz'ilanem re samaj re', niqatz'ët ri ruk'u'x jikomal. Achi'el, yeqamöl chuqa' yeqayäk ri IP taq ochochib'äl richin ye'ilitäj chuqa' yeq'at ri ye'okisan ri samaj richin yekanon ichinan taq ruxaq.

To provide Activity Stream, we fetch metadata about websites you have visited, such as images and icons, using a service called Embedly. We send these requests to Embedly through Mozilla's servers, so they will not be associated with you.

Richin niqasüj ri Activity Stream chawe. yeqakanoj taq kichintzij ri taq ruxaq ye'atz'ët, achi'el taq wachib'äl chuqa' taq wachaj, rik'in jun samaj rub'ina'am Embedly. Kik'in ri taq ruk'u'x rusamaj Mozilla yeqatäq ri taq k'utunïk chi re ri Embedly, richin man kekixïm awik'in.
To provide cached versions of pages, we send 404 error page URLs to Archive.org. Archive.org discloses its privacy policy here.
Richin yeqasüj kaxlanweyin taq ruwäch, xqatäq ri URLs richin ri ruxaq sachoj 404 chi re Archive.org. Archive.org yatikïr nawïl ri runa'ojil ichinanem pa wawe'.

To provide Universal Search, we use a few third-party services. We use Bing and Yahoo to provide recommendations, and Embedly and Clearbit to provide additional data (such as images or icons) about those recommendations. To display the recommendations in the Awesome Bar, Universal Search may download those images directly from Embedly and Clearbit, which may allow those services to see your IP address and the image requested.

Richin yojtikïr niqasüj ri Universal Seach chawe, qak'ulun kisamaj aj rox winäq: Bing and Yahoo richin ri taq chilab'enïk, chuqa' Embedly chuqa' Clearbit richin rutz'aqat etamab'äl (taq wachib'äl o taq wachaj) chi kij ri taq chilab'enïk ri'. Richin yeqak'üt pa ri Na'anel Kajtz'ik, ri Universal Search rik'in jub'a' yeruqasaj ri taq wachib'äl ri' pa Embedly chuqa' Clearbit, ri nuya' q'ij chi ke richin nikitz'ët ri IP awochichib'al chuqa' ri taq wachib'äl xek'utüx.

Tracking Protection will prompt you for feedback when it blocks a tracker. We collect basic usage data when you engage with this prompt, such as when you enable or disable the trackers on the page or report a problem.

Ri Chajinïk chuwäch Ojqanem xtuk'utuj atzij toq xtuq'ät jun ojqanel. Niqamöl ruk'u'x etamab'äl toq naya' ri atzij achi'el toq ye'atzïj o ye'achüp ri taq ojqanela' pa ri ruxaq o toq naya' rutzijol jun k'ayewal.

Voice Fill will also collect information about your use of the feature, such as how frequently Voice Fill is used and whether you used Voice Fill with specific tabs or pages such as Google, DuckDuckGo, or Yahoo.

Voice Fill chuqa' xtumöl etamab'äl chi rij rokisaxik rusamaj, achi'el chuqa' jarupe' mul nokisäx Voice Fill chuqa' we nawokisaj ri Voice Fill rik'in taq ruwi' o jikïl taq ruxaq k'amaya'l achi'el Google, DuckDuckGo o Yahoo.

Voice Fill will collect technical information related to the performance of the feature, such as how long it takes for our servers to process a submitted recording and whether you selected or modified any of the suggestions we gave.

Voice Fill xtumöl ri samajel etamab'äl ruximon ri' rik'in ri rub'eyal nisamäj, achi'el jarupe' ramaj nuk'waj chuwächi ri ruk'u'x qasamaj richin nikib'än ruk'ojlem jun yakoj taqon chuqa' we acha'on o ajalon jun chi ke ri taq chilab'enïk qaya'on chawe.
Voice Fill will soon be available as an add-on for all Firefox users. If you have the experiment installed, you will be updated automatically.
Nipe yan, Voice Fill xtiwachin achi'el tz'aqat kichin rokisanela' Firefox. We ayakon, ruyonil xtuk'exela' ri'.
Watch results appear (like magic!) as you type your search into the URL bar.
Tatz'eta' rub'eyal yewachin pe ri nakanoj (achi'el man relik ta) toq yatz'ib'an ri nakanoj pa rukajtz'ik URL.
Watch video in the foreground while you do other things on the Web.

We also collect basic information about your browser profile that affect Activity Stream, such as the number of bookmarks and history items.
Chuqa' niqamöl ri awetamab'al chi rij ri ruwäch ab'i' pa ri okik'amaya'l nawokisaj rik'in Activity Stream, achi'el ri kajlab'al taq yaketal chuqa' kich'akulal ri natab'äl.

We also collect data on the number of times you encounter a playable video, the number of times you played the video and the video service that provided the video. This helps us understand how useful our users are finding the experiment.

Chuqa' niqamöl etamab'äl chi kij ri janipe' mul nib'ewachin pe jun silowachib'äl, ri tikirel nitzij, ri janipe' mul ye'atzïj chuqa' ri ruk'u'x samaj xya'o. Re re' nuya' q'ij chi qe nino' pa qawi' ri ruk'a'tz ri solna'oj chi kiwa ri winaqi'.
We also collect information about the way you use tabs, such as the number of tabs you keep open at a time, and length of time you keep tabs open.
Chuqa' niqamöl etamab'äl chi rij ri rub'eyal ye'awokisaj ri taq ruwi', achi'el jarupe' taq ruwi' chuqa' jarupe' ramaj ye'ajäq.
We are working on a full report. Check back soon for the details.
Tajin niqasamajij jun tz'aqät rutzijol. K'a xkatzolin pe richin ye'atz'ët ri taq rub'anikil.
We collect basic usage data regarding how you interact with experimental new tab and timeline pages, such as the types of elements that you click and their position on the page.
Yeqamöl ruxe'el etamab'äl chi rij ri nab'än rik'in ri k'ak'a' solna'oj ruwi' chuqa' ri kixaq taq cholajem, achi'el ri taq ch'akulaj e'apitz'on chuqa' ri ruk'ojlem pa ri ruxaq.

We collect basic usage data regarding how you interact with the Awesome Bar (address bar), such as the number of characters typed, the types of results that you click, and their position in the results list.
Niqamöl ruk'u'x etamab'äl toq nawokisaj ri Na'anel Kajtz'ik (kikajtz'ik taq ochochib'äl), achi'el jarupe' taq tz'ib' ye'atz'ib'aj, ri kiwäch taq kanoxïk ye'acha' chuqa' ri kik'ojlem pa ri cholb'äl.

We collect basic usage on how many times you encounter a Page Not Found error (code 404), how many times a cached version of that page exists from Archive.org, and how many times you choose to view the cached version.

Niqamöl ruxe'el etamab'äl chi rij jarupe' mul nel pe ri Man Xilitäj ta ri Ruxaq (b'itz'ib' 404), jampe' mul toq k'o jun ruwäch kaxlanweyin pa ri ruxaq richin Archive.org chuqa' jarupe' mul nacha' natz'ët ri ruwäch kaxlanweyin.
We collect usage data regarding how you interact with the Tab Center, such as how often you maximize or pin Tab Center.
Niqamöl etamab'äl chi rij ri nab'än rik'in ri Tab Center, achi'el jarupe' mul ye'animirisaj o ye'aya' kan ri taq ruwi' pa Tab Center.
We collect usage data to help us understand your interactions with the product, such as the number of times you click the shots button, save an image, or encounter an error saving an image.

Yeqamöl re taq etamab'äl re' richin nino' pan qawi' ri nab'än rik'in ri tikojil, achi'el jarupe' mul napïtz' pa ruwi' ri rupitz'b'al chapoj, toq nayäk jun wachib'äl o we niqa'alajin pe jun sachoj toq nayäk kan.
We collect usage data when you engage with the context menu, experiment icon and player controls.
Yeqamöl taq tzij richin okisaxïk toq yatok pa ruk'utsamaj rokem, pa ruwachaj solna'ojinem chuqa' pa ri taq ruk'wayöl winäq.
We created some preset themes to help you get started.
Eqatz'ukun jujun taq wachinel eqajikib'an richin yatkito' richin natikirisaj el.
We do not collect information about the specific videos you encounter.
Man niqamöl ta etamab'äl chi kij ri taq silowachib'äl ri ye'awïl.
We do not collect URLs of the pages you request or the URLs we send to Archive.org.
Man yeqamöl ta taq URLs kichin ri taq ruxaq ye'akanoj o ri taq URLs ri yeqatäq pa Archive.org.

We may share survey results you submit to us and aggregated telemetry data related to this experiment with the Internet Archive.

We’re building the next generation of Firefox, and we’re focusing on real-world speed and performance. Pulse lets you give our engineers feedback about your experience on websites that work well in Firefox and on websites that don’t.

Tajin niqatz'ük' ri k'ak'a' ralk'walaxnem Firefox, chuqa' qaya'on qatzub'al pa ruwi' ri anin k'aslem pa ruwach'ulew chuqa' ri samaj nib'an. Pulse nuya' q'ij chawe naya' tzij chi ke ri qanojk'ayel chi rij awetamab'al pa ruwi' ruxaq ajk'amaya'l yesamäj ütz rik'in Firefox chuqa' ri man ütz ta yesamäj rik'in.

We store your shots on Mozilla's servers and will have access to those shots. However, we will only access your shots when reasonably necessary for the operation of the service, such as when someone sends us the link to a shot using our "flag" feature, or to diagnose any problems. We will also analyze all shots in the aggregate to help improve Page Shot, for example, by identifying the average size and number of shots taken by users.

Yeqayäk ri taq achapoj pa ruk'u'x rusamaj Mozilla chuqa' yojtikïr yojok chi kipam. Xa xe yojok toq nik'atzin chi yeqasamajij, achi'el toq k'o jun nutäq chi qe ruximonel jun chapoj, akuchi' nrokisaj ri samaj "taq etal" o chuqa' richin nich'ob' kij taq k'ayewal. Chuqa' yeqanik'oj konojel ri taq chapoj richin niqutzilaj ri Page Shot; achi'el richin niya' retal ri runik'ajal runimilem chuqa' jarupe' taq chapoj nikib'än ri qawinaq.

We've also built great new app experiences like { -exp-lockbox } and { -exp-send } which continue to push { -brand } beyond the browser. Look for exciting new developments from both of these projects in 2019.

Chuqa' yeqatz'ük jeb'ël taq etamab'äl kik'in k'ak'a' taq chokoy achi'el { -exp-lockbox } chuqa' { -exp-send } ri nik'ïy { -brand } chuwäch ri okik'amaya'l. Tawoyob'ej k'ak'a' taq kik'iyirisanik re ka'i' nuk'samaj re' pa 2019.
We’ve built some basic formatting options into Notes. With your feedback we will add more features.
Xeqanük' jujun taq kicha'oj ruk'u'x b'anikil pa Notes. Matyox chi re ana'oj, xkeqatz'aqatisaj ch'aqa' chik taq samaj.

When you engage with a prompt, we also collect information about the page you are on and the tracking domain that is being blocked. This helps us understand when and why you are experiencing a problem.

Toq naya' atzij, chuqa' niqamöl etamab'äl chi rij ri ruxaq akuchi' at k'o wi chuqa' ri ruk'ojlem rub'ey kanoxïk q'aton. Re re' yojruto' richin niq'ax pan qawi' jampe' chuqa' aruma yek'ulwachitäj ri taq k'ayewal.

When you use Send, Mozilla receives an encrypted copy of the file you upload, and basic information about the file, such as filename, file hash and file size. Mozilla does not have the ability to access the content of your encrypted file, and only keeps it for the time or number of downloads indicated.

Toq nawokisaj ri Send, ri Mozilla nuk'ül jun ewan rusik'ixik ruwachib'al ri yakb'äl najotob'a' chuqa' ri retamab'al ri yakb'äl, achi'el rub'i' ri yakb'äl, ri jax chuqa' ri runimilem. Ri Mozilla man nitikïr ta nok chupam ri yakb'äl ewan rusik'ixik, chuqa' xa xe k'o pa ruq'a' ri ramaj chuqa' ri rajlab'al qasanïk xsik'ïx yan.
When you use the Awesome Bar, we send the terms you type to our recommendation engine. We keep anonymous logs of popular searches to improve the quality of our recommendations.

“For me, working on Thimble is not just about gaining valuable programming experience but more importantly a feeling of accomplishment and contributing to a product that is used by people all around the world. Realizing that millions of people benefit from the code I write is what drove me to apply to work on Thimble. The other important factor is the friendly and supportive community within the project which is another reason that makes my open source development experience with Thimble fascinating.”

“Chi nuwäch rïn ri samaj pa Thimble man xa xe ta richin ninwetamaj pa ruwi' kemotz'ib'anem, ja ri nana' toq k'o naq'i' chuqa' ri yatikïr yato'on rik'in jun tikojil nikokisaj ri winaqi' chijun ri ruwach'ulew. Ri xuyäk nuk'u'x richin ninsamajij Thimble ja toq xinya' retal chi t'ijtäq chi winaqi' yeruto' ri b'itz'ib' yentz'ib'aj. Ri jun chik nimaläj retal ri nub'än chi ri wetamab'al pa ruwi' kib'anik jaqäl b'itz'ib' pa Thimble yalan ajna' ja ri nïm tinamït e k'o chi rij.”

“Jumping into Thimble the first time around was daunting. But then I started to contribute, and it became satisfying. I learned a lot about what I usually sidelined — web development. In Open Source development, I never felt alone. Bring all these talented minds together, and something as great as Thimble can happen.”

“Toq ninjäq Thimble nab'ey mul xusäch nuk'u'x. Po toq xito'on, xkiköt nuk'u'x. K'ïy xinwetamaj pa kiwi' ri taq wachinäq ri junelïk yenjech'uj kan chuqa' pa ruwi' — ajk'amaya'l b'anoj. Majub'ey xinna' chi nuyonil in k'o toq yeb'anala' jaqäl b'itz'ib'. Yerutün ajwi' taq winäq chuqa' xtalüx jun utziläj wachinäq achi'el Thimble.”

“Prior to Thimble, I worked with relatively small programs that I coded myself or in a small group. Working on code that spans hundreds (probably thousands!) of files being worked on by over 300 people definitely opened up my mind in what “working with others” could mean. I found that there is definitely a learning curve to get used to the environment, but there's always friendly faces that will help you get started as well as with troubles you may have along the way. Just after a few months, I'm able to contribute to the community more than I imagined before. Imagine the possibilities that we can all achieve together as open source continues to grow!”

“Chuwäch xintikirisaj Thimble, inusamajin chik ko'öl taq kema' ri xenb'itz'ib'aj nuyonil o chuqa' kik'in ch'aqa' chik winaqi'. yitikïr ninjikib'a' chi yasamäj kik'in b'itz'ib' e k'o pa wok'altäq (rik'in jub'a' chuqa' xo'iltäq) taq yakb'äl achoq kik'in yesamäj man xa xe ta 300 winaqi', xuk'üt chi nuwäch ri rejqalem “yasamäj kik'in ch'aqa' chik”. Kan qitzij chi k'o rub'eyal richin nawetamaj ke ri' nuk'uluj qa chawe pa jun k'ojlib'äl, po junelïk e k'o ch'a'äl taq winäq, ri yeto'on awichin richin natikirisaj chuqa' chuwäch ri ak'ayewal. Xa xe pa jujun taq ik', yitikïr chik yito'on achi'el ri majub'ey xinna'ojij. ¡Ruma ri' tana'ojij achike yojtikïr niqïl we nik'iyïr ri runa'ojib'al jaqäl b'itz'ib'!”

Thimble by Mozilla - An online code editor for learners & educators.
Thimble ruma Mozilla - Jun runuk'unel b'itz'ib' pa k'amab'ey kichin tijoxela' chuqa' tijonela'.
Thimble comes with a dark and light theme, so pick what's best for you. You can also change other options like the size of the text.
Thimble rutz'aqatisan jun ruwachinel saqsöj saqil chuqa' jun chik q'equ'm, richin yatikïr nacha'. Chuqa' yatikïr najäl ch'aqa' chik taq cha'oj, achi'el ri runimilem rucholajem tzij.
Man tikirel ta nitikirisäx ri Thimble.

Thimble is a full-featured code editor that runs right in the browser. It's designed to help new coders create their own sites and web-based projects using HTML, CSS & JavaScript. Everything you need is at your fingertips, allowing you (or your classroom) to get up and running as quickly as possible.

Thimble jun runuk'unel b'itz'ib' ch'akulan ri nisamajïx pan okik'amaya'l. Wachib'en richin yeruto' ri k'ak'a' kemonela' chi yekitz'ük ruxaq kik'amaya'l chuqa' kinimasamaj akuchi' nikojqaj ri ajk'amaya'l rik'in HTML, CSS & JavaScript. Ronojel ri nik'atzin chawe nikiya' pan aq'a', nikiya' q'ij chawe (o chi ke atijoxela') nachäp rusamajixik pan aninäq.

Thimble is an Open Source project created by the Mozilla Foundation in partnership with CDOT at Seneca College. Since the beginning, contributors from all over the world have played an important role in making it a success.

Ri Thimble jun Jaqäl B'itz'ib' nimasamaj nuk'un ruma ri Mozilla Moloj rik'in kito'ik ri CDOT pa Seneca College. To'onela' chijun ri ruwach'ulew yalan rejqalem kisamaj pa rutikirib'al richin chi yalan jeb'ël.
Thimble is an online code editor that makes it easy to create and publish your own web pages while learning HTML, CSS & JavaScript.
Thimble jun runuk'unel b'itz'ib' pa k'amab'ey, ri chanin nunük' chuqa' nutaluj rutzijol taq ruxaq awajk'amaya'l toq nawetamaj chuqa' HTML, CSS & JavaScript.

“We all need people who will give us feedback. That's how we improve. Working with Thimble was the most encouraging experience for me in opensource world and it gave me a chance to work with most friendly and supporting team.”

“Qonojel nik'atzin chi qe ri kitzij ch'aqa' chik winaqi' ke ri' toq niqab'än qutzil qi'. Ri nusamaj pa Thimble, xok jun jeb'ël etamab'äl pa ruwi' ri ruk'ojlib'al jaqäl b'itz'ib', ruma xuya' q'ij chwe chi xisamäj rik'in jun molaj, ri e ch'a'äl chuqa junelïk nikajo yatkito'.”

“When first starting on Thimble I had little to no experience/knowledge of JavaScript. It took me a while to get my bearings. As I started working on this project I had many hurdles to cross. But with the help of the core team I was able to slowly cross those hurdles. I still have lots to learn, but I'm happy with the progress so far!”

“Toq nab'ey mul xitikirisaj ri Thimble, jub'a' ok wetamab'al/knowledge chi rij ri JavaScript. Pa rutikirib'al k'ayew jub'a' xub'än chi nuwäch. Toq xinchäp samaj pa re nimasamaj re', xenwïl ka'i' oxi' taq k'ayewal. Po rik'in kito'ik ri molaj, eqal jub'a' po jikïl, junelïk xinel chuwäch. K'a k'ïy na nrajo' chi ninwetamaj, ¡wakami yikikot rik'in ri wetamab'al!”
Work faster by making use a handy list of HTML, CSS & JavaScript code snippets that you can include in your code.
Chanin kasamäj rik'in nanük' kicholajem taq ruk'aj rub'itz'ib' HTML, CSS & JavaScript ri yatikïr natz'aqatisaj pa ri ab'itz'ib'.
Working on some JavaScript? Thimble's built-in console makes it easier than ever to test and debug your code.
¿La yasamäj rik'in ri JavaScript? Ri tz'aqatisan rutemeb'al Thimble man k'ayew ta nub'än chawäch ri rutojtob'enik chuqa' ruchojmirisaxik ri b'itz'ib'.

“Working on Thimble has been a great experience. The code is very well written and the mentors are really supportive. It is one of the best projects to work in if you want to start working on open source and contributing has taught me a lot about open source best practices.”

“Ri samaj pa Thimble jun jeb'ël etamab'äl. Jeb'ël tz'ib'an ri b'itz'ib' chuqa' yalan ütz kina'oj ri ajpixa'. Jun chi ke ri utziläj taq nimasamaj akuchi' yatikïr yato'on we nawajo' yasamajij jaqäl b'itz'ib'. Ri to'onïk ruk'utun chi nuwäch ri jeb'ël ok pa ruwi' ri jaqäl b'itz'ib'.”

“Working with thimble proved to be challenging and explosive way to get into open source. It really made me collaborate and work with some amazing individuals, which always made you feel like your mistakes are merely opportunities to further improve your releases. Persistence is key, and always turn feedback into a lesson opportunity!”

“Ri samaj rik'in Thimble nuk'üt chi jun ch'ojinel chuqa' jeb'ël rub'anikil richin yatok chupam ri jaqäl b'itz'ib'. Xitikïr xito'on chuqa' xisamäj kik'in ajna' winäq, ri nikik'üt chawäch chi ri taq k'ayewal e rutzil k'aslem ri k'o chi nib'an kik'ojlem. Ri ruk'u'x chi tatija' aq'ij ¡chuqa' tetamäx chi rij ronojel!”
Write CSS styles for your elements without switching away from the HTML page that you are editing. Put the text cursor on any element tag and hit Cmd/Ctrl + E to start writing CSS styles.

{ $command } <status message>: set the status to { $status } with an optional status message.

{ $commandName }: Display a list of chat rooms on the network. Warning, some servers may disconnect you upon doing this.

{ $commandName }: Displays the current local time at the IRC server.
{ $commandName }: Tik'ut pe ri ramaj k'o wakami pa ri IRC k'uxasamaj.
{ $commandName } [<channel>] [(+|-)<new mode> [<parameter>][,<parameter>]*]: Get, set, or unset a channel mode.
{ $commandName } [<q'asab'äl>] [(+|-)<k'ak'a' b'eual> [<ko'öl etab'äl>][,<ko'öl etab'äl>]*]: Tik'ul, tib'an runuk'ulem, o tichup rub'anikil q'asab'äl.
{ $commandName } <nuk'uj>: Titaq jun nuk'uj chi re ri ChanServ.
{ $commandName } <nuk'uj>: Titaq jun nuk'uj chi re ri MemoServ.
{ $commandName } <nuk'uj>: Titaq jun nuk'uj chi re ri NickServ.
{ $commandName } <nuk'uj>: Titaq jun nuk'uj chi re ri OperServ.
{ $commandName } <command>: Send a raw command to the server.
{ $commandName } <command>: Titaq jun man samajin ta chi nuk'uj chi re ri k'uxasamaj.
{ $commandName } <jid>[<message>]: Invite a user to join the current room with an optional message.
{ $commandName } <jid>[<message>]: Tipeyöx jun winäq richin nok pa jay k'o wakami rik'in jun cha'el rutzijol.
{ $commandName } <message>: Disconnect from the server, with an optional message.
{ $commandName } <message>: Telesäx el pa ri k'uxasamaj, rik'in jun cha'el tzijol.
{ $commandName } [<message>]: Leave the current room with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [<message>]: Tiya' kan ri jay k'o wakami rik'in jun cha'el rutzijol.
{ $commandName } (+|-)<new mode>: Set or unset a user mode.
{ $commandName } (+|-)<new mode>: Man tinuk' o tinuk' jun rub'anikil winäq.
{ $commandName } [<new topic>]: Titz'et ri ruwachinel re q'asab'äl re'.
{ $commandName } [<new topic>]: Titz'et ri ruwachinel re jay re'.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Grant channel operator status to someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Tiya' q'ij chi re jun winäq richin nok ruk'alab'anel b'ey. K'o chi jun ajk'alab'anel b'ey richin nub'än re re'.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Grant channel voice status to someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Tiya' q'ij chi re jun winäq richin nok ruk'oxom b'ey. K'o chi jun ajk'alab'anel b'ey richin nub'än re re'.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Remove channel operator status from someone. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Tiyuj el rub'anikil rusamajel b'ey pa ri rub'ey jun winäq. Richin nab'än ri' k'o at rusamajel jun b'ey.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Remove channel voice status from someone, preventing them from speaking if the channel is moderated (+m). You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick1>[,<nick2>]*: Tiyuj ri rub'anikil rusïk' rub'ey jun winäq, rik'in ruq'atik ruch'ab'äl we tajin k'wan ri b'ey (+m). K'o chi at rusamajel b'ey richin nab'än re re'.
{ $commandName } [<nick>]: Asks how much lag a user (or the server if no user specified) has.
{ $commandName } [<nick>]: Tik'utüx janipe' yoköl ri winäq (o ri k'amab'ey we man jikib'an ta ri winäq).
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Ban someone from the room. You must be a room administrator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Tiyuj el jun pa re jay re'. K'o chi at runuk'samajel jay richin yatikïr nab'än re'.
{ $commandName } <nick> [<message>]: Remove someone from a channel. You must be a channel operator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick> [<message>]: Tiyuj el jun pa jun q'asab'äl. K'o chi at ruk'wayonel q'asab'äl richin yatikïr nab'än re'.
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Remove someone from the room. You must be a room moderator to do this.
{ $commandName } <nick>[<message>]: Tiyuj el jun pa re jay re'. K'o chi at runuk'samajel jay richin yatikïr nab'än re'.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Send a private message to a participant in the room.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Titaq jun ichinan tzijol chi re jun ruto'onel re jay re'.
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Send a private message to a user (as opposed to a channel).
{ $commandName } <nick> <message>: Titaq jun ichinan tzijol chi re jun winäq (junwi chuwäch jun q'asab'äl).
{ $commandName } <nick> [(+|-)<mode>]: Get, set or unset a user's mode.
{ $commandName } <nick> [(+|-)<mode>]: Tik'ul, tib'an runuk'ulem o tichup rub'anikil jun winäq.
{ $commandName } <nick> <msg>: Sends a CTCP message to the nick.
{ $commandName } <nick> <msg>: Titaq jun CTCP tzijol chi re ri nick.
{ $commandName } <nick>[ <nick>]* [<channel>]: Invite one or more nicks to join you in the current channel, or to join the specified channel.
{ $commandName }<nick>[ <nick>]* [<q'asab'äl>]: Tapeyoj jun o ch'aqa' chik winäq richin nikitün pe ki' pa re wakami q'asab'äl o richin nutün ri' ri cha'on q'asab'äl.
{ $commandName } <nick>: Request the version of a user's client.
{ $commandName } <nick>: Tik'utüx ri ruwäch jun ruwinaq winäq.
{ $commandName } <nick!user@host>: Ban the users matching the given pattern.
{ $commandName } <nick!user@host>: Tiq'il chi kiwäch ri winaqi' chi nikijunamaj ki' rik'in ri retab'alil ya'on.
{ $commandName } <room1>[ <key1>][,<room2>[ <key2>]]*: Enter one or more channels, optionally providing a channel key for each if needed.
{ $commandName } <room1>[ <key1>][,<room2>[ <key2>]]*: Tatz'ib'aj jun o ch'aqa' chik q'asab'äl, akuchi' nacha' we natz'ib'aj jun ruk'u'x rutzij q'asab'äl qichin chi kijujunal we ke ri' najowäx.
{ $commandName } [<room>[@<server>][/<nick>]] [<password>]: Join a room, optionally providing a different server, or nickname, or the room password.
{ $commandName } [<room>[@<server>][/<nick>]] [<password>]: Katok pa jun jay, ütz naya' jun junwi chi k'uxasamaj, jun tz'ukun b'i'aj o ri ewan rutzij ri jay.
{ $commandName } <room jid>[<password>]: Invite your conversation partner to join a room, together with its password if required.
{ $commandName } <room jid>[<password>]: Tipeyöx jun ajtzijonem achib'il richin nok pa jay, rik'in ri ewan rutzij we nik'utüx.
{ $commandName } <target> <message>: Send a notice to a user or channel.
{ $commandName } <target> <message>: Titaq jun tzijol chi re jun winäq o q'asab'äl.
{ $commandName } [message]: Leave the current channel with an optional message.
{ $commandName } [message]: Tiya' kan ri q'asab'äl k'o wakami rik'in jun cha'el tzijol.
{ $commandName }: Request information about the client your conversation partner is using.
{ $commandName }: Tik'utüx retamab'al winäq ri tajin nrokisaj ri ajtzijonem achib'il.
Taq nuk'uj: { $command }. Tokisäx /help <nuk'uj> richin ch'aqa' chik etamab'äl.

• Re re' rik'in jub'a' jun k'ayewal rik'in ri runuk'ulem k'uxasamaj o rik'in jub'a' k'o ri nutojtob'ej nuq'alajisaj ri' achi'el ri k'uxasamaj.
  • We ütz atokinäq pa re k'uxasamaj re' ojer kan, ri sachoj rik'in jub'a' jun mej ke ri' xtub'än ruma ri' yatikïr natojtob'ej chik pa jun ch'utiramaj.
• This problem can sometimes be caused by disabling or refusing to accept cookies.
• Re jun k'ayewal re' nik'ulwachitäj ruma nachüp o e'aq'aton kik'ulik ri taq kaxlanwey.

• Web addresses are usually written like http://www.example.com/
  • Make sure that you're using forward slashes (i.e. /).

• Ri taq rochochib'al Ajk'amaya'l jutaqil yetz'ib'äx achi'el http://www.example.com/
  • Tajikib'a' chi ye'awokisaj ri ütz taq kajtz'ik (achi'el. /).
• You might need to install other software to open this address.

At the heart of Thunderbird is an open source development process driven by thousands of passionate, experienced developers and security experts spread all over the world. Our openness and active community of experts helps to ensure our products are more secure and quickly updated, while also enabling us to take advantage of the best third party security scanning and evaluation tools to further bolster overall security.

If you like Firefox’s tabbed browsing, you’re going to love tabbed email. Tabbed email lets you load emails in separate tabs so you can quickly jump between them. Perhaps you’re responding to an email and need to refer back to an earlier email. Tabbed email lets you keep multiple emails open for easy reference.
