Smart Folders help you manage multiple email accounts by combining special folders like your Inbox, Sent, or Archive folder. Instead of going to the Inbox for each of your mail accounts, you can see all of your incoming email in one Inbox folder.

Ri na'owinäq taq molyakb'äl nikiya' q'ij chawe ye'anuk'samajij k'ïy taq retal taqoya'l rik'in kitunïk pa jun nimaläj molyakb'äl achi'el ri ataqob'äl, taq taqon, o ri yakb'äl molyakb'äl. Pa ruk'exel yab'e pa ri taqob'äl kichin jujun taq taqoya'l, yatikïr ye'atz'ët ri taq rutzijol pa xa xe jun rumolyakb'äl taqob'äl.

The Activity Manager records all the interactions between Thunderbird and your email provider in one place. There’s no more guess work. You only have to look in one place to see everything that’s happening with your email.

Ri runuk'samajel samaj nuyäk konojel ri taq ch'ab'enïk chi kikojol Thunderbird chuqa' ri ya'öl ataqoya'l pa jun k'ojlib'äl. Majun chik taq samaj ri man e tz'aqät ta. Xa xe k'o chi yatzu'un pa jun k'ojlib'äl richin natz'ët achike nik'ulwachij ri ataqoya'l.
The attachment reminder looks for the word attachment (and other words like file types) in the body of your message and reminds you to add an attachment before hitting send.

Ri Runatab'al taqoj nukanoj rik'in ri rutzij taqoj (chuqa' ch'aqa' chik taq tzij achi'el kiwäch taq yakb'äl) pa ruch'akulal ri rutzijol ataqoj chuqa' nunataj chawe chi tatz'aqatisaj el jun taqoj chuwäch natäq el.

The Quick Filter Toolbar lets you filter your email faster. Start typing in words in the Quick Filter search box and the results are displayed instantly. Or you can filter your email by New Messages, Tags, and people in your Address Book. You can also "Pin" or save a Filter and use it across multiple folders.

Ri kiyuqtz'ik taq rusamajib'al Aninäq Chayunïk nuya' q'ij chawe ye'achayuj chanin ri taq ataqoya'l. Tatikirisaj ye'atz'ib'aj taq tzij pa ri rukanob'al Aninäq chayunïk pa aninäq yeb'echolajitäj pe. Chuqa' yatikïr ye'achayuj ri taq taqoya'l ruma K'ak'a' taq Rutzijol, taq Etal chuqa' ri winaqi' e k'o pa ochochib'äl tz'ib'awuj. Chuqa' yatikïr "Pin" o nayäq jun chayub'äl richin nawokisaj kik'in jalajöj taq cholyakb'äl.

The search interface in Thunderbird contains filtering and timeline tools to pinpoint the exact email you’re looking for. Thunderbird also indexes all of your emails to help you search even faster. Your search results are displayed in a tab so you can easily switch back and forth to your search results and other email.

Ri ruk'amal kanob'äl pa Thunderbird ruk'wan taq rusamajib'al chayunïk chuqa' ruk'amaya'l q'ijul richin niya' retal ri qitzij taqoya'l tajin nakanoj. Thunderbird yenuk' konojel ri taq ataqoya'l richin yatruto' aninäq rik'in jun kanoxïk. Ri aq'i'oj richin kanoxïk xkek'ut pe pa jun ruwi' richin yatikïr aninäq najalwachij chi rij o chuwäch ri taq q'i'oj xe'ilitäj chuqa' ri ch'aqa' chik taq taqoya'l.
Thunderbird is a free email application that’s easy to set up and customize - and it’s loaded with great features!
Thunderbird jun ruchokoy sipan taqoya'l, ri man k'ayew ta ninuk'ub'ëx chuqa' nichinäx - ¡k'ïy taq rub'anikil ruk'amon pe!

Thunderbird is currently transitioning to an independent organization. Being independent, we can shape our own fate, but there is significant infrastructure that must be maintained to deliver the application to our tens of millions of users. For Thunderbird to survive and continue to evolve, we need your support and ask for your donation today. All the money donated will go directly to funding Thunderbird development and infrastructure.

Thunderbird tajin niq'axäx pa jun alaj k'aslem chi moloj. Toq alaj ruk'aslem yojtikïr niqachojmirisaj ri qak'aslem, xa xe chi k'o jun nimaläj ch'akulal ri k'o chi nisamajïx richin nijach ri chokoy chi ke ri kab'lajtäq chi t'ijtäq qawinaq. Chuwäch Thunderbird richin chi k'äs chuqa' richin nujalwachila' ri', niqajo' ri ato'ik ruma ri' toq niqak'utuj ri asipanik wakami. Ronojel ri pwäq xtimol choj xtib'e richin nutojb'ej rub'anik ri Thunderbird chuqa' ri rucholnuk'ulem.

Thunderbird is the leading open source, cross-platform email and calendaring client, free for business and personal use. We want it to stay secure and become even better.
Thunderbird ruwinaq rajpop ri jaqäl b'itz'ib', taqoya'l k'ïy nuk'uche'el chuqa' cholq'ij, ri man nok ta pa k'ayinïk chuqa' man ichinan ta. Niqajo' chi ütz tub'ana' chuqa' junelïk tutzïr.
Thunderbird offers support for user privacy and remote image protection. To ensure a user’s privacy, Thunderbird automatically blocks remote images in email messages.

Thunderbird nusüj to'ïk richin ri richinanem qawinaq chuqa' kichajinïk näj taq wachib'äl. Richin nijikib'äl richinanem qawinaq, Thunderbird pa ruyonil yeruq'ät näj taq wachib'äl pa taq rutzijol taqoya'l.

Thunderbird protects you from email scams which try to trick users into handing over personal and confidential information by indicating when a message is a potential phishing attempt. As a second line of defense, Thunderbird warns you when you click on a link which appears to be taking you to a different Web site than the one indicated by the URL in the message.

Thuderbird yatruchajij chuwäch eläq' pa taqoya'l, ri nitojtob'ej yekiq'öl ri taq qawinaq richin nikijäch ketamab'al toq jun rutzijol kan jun rutojtob'enïk k'exonel. Achi'el jun ruka'n rutzijol kolïk, Thunderbird nuya' rutzijol chawe jampe' k'o chi napïtz' pa ruwi' jun ximonel, ri achi'el ta chi yatruk'waj pa jun chik wi chi ruxaq k'amaya'l man achi'el ta ri nuk'üt ri rochochib'al URL richin ri rutzijol.

Ri kich'utitzijol Thunderbird ruwäch e richin chi kijujunal ri taq ruwäch chokoy. Tacha' ri ruwäch pa re rucholajem re' richin ye'atz'ët ri taq ruch'utitzijol ri ruwäch ri'.

Ri kich'utitzijol Thunderbird ruwäch e richin chi kijujunal ri taq ruwäch chokoy. Tacha' ri ruwäch pa re rucholajem re' richin ye'atz'ët ri taq ruch'utitzijol ri ruwäch ri'.

Thunderbird’s popular junk mail tools have been updated to stay ahead of spam. Each email you receive passes through Thunderbird’s leading-edge junk mail filters. Each time you mark messages as spam, Thunderbird "learns" and improves its filtering so you can spend more time reading the mail that matters. Thunderbird can also use your mail provider’s spam filters to keep junk mail out of your inbox.

Ri ajtz'etel taq rusamajib'al seq' taqoya'l richin Thunderbird, xk'ex richin nik'oje' chuwäch ri seq'tz'ijol. Chi jujun ri taq taqoya'l xe'ak'ül yeq'ax pa jun nima'q taq chayub'äl richin seq' taqoya'l richin Thunderbird. Toq naya' retal jun rutzijol chi seq'tzijol, Thunderbird "nretamaj" chuqa' nurutzilaj ri chayunïk richin chi naya' k'ïy ruq'ijul ye'asik'ij ri nimaläj taq taqoya'l. Thunderbird chuqa' nitikïr yerokisaj ri taq ruchayub'al seq'tzijol richin ri aya'öl taqoya'l richin man yek'oje' ta ri taq seq' taqoya'l pa taqob'äl.

Thunderbird’s update system checks to see if you’re running the latest version, and notifies you when a security update is available. These security updates are small (usually 200KB - 700KB), giving you only what you need and making the security update quick to download and install. The automated update system provides updates for Thunderbird on Windows, macOS, and Linux in over 40 different languages.

Ri kiq'inoj taq ruk'exoj Thunderbird nunik'oj we tajin nib'anatäj ri ruk'isib'äl ruwäch, chuqa' nuya' rutzijol chawe toq k'o jun ruk'exoj jikomal. Re taq kik'exoj jikomal re' e koköj ok (junelïk 200KB - 700KB) ri nikiya' chawe xa xe ri nik'atzin chawe rik'in ri' nikib'än chi re ri ruk'exoj jikomal aninäq richin naqasäx kan chuqa' niyak qa. Ri kiq'inoj yonil taq k'exoj nikiya' taq k'exoj richin Thunderbird pa Windows, macOS chuqa' Linux pa jotöl chi re ri 40 jalajöj taq ch'ab'äl.

Thunderbird’s update system checks to see if you’re running the latest version, and notifies you when a security update is available. These security updates are small (usually 200KB - 700KB), giving you only what you need and making the security update quick to download and install. The automated update system provides updates for Thunderbird on Windows, OS X, and Linux in over 40 different languages.

Ri runuk'ulem ruk'exoj Thunderbird nunik'oj we nisamajïx ri k'ak'a' ruwäch chuqa' nuya' rutzijol chawe toq k'o jun ruk'exoj jikomal. Re taq ruk'exoj jikomal re' taq e koköj (jutaqil 200KB - 700KB), ri nub'än chi nuya' xa xe ri nrajo' chuqa' nub'än chi ri ruk'exoj jikomal aninäq niqasäx chuqa' niyak. Ri runuk'ulem ruyonil k'exoj nub'än ruk'exoj Thunderbird pa Windows, OS X, chuqa' Linux pa jotöl chi re ri 40 jalajöj taq ch'ab'äl.
To ensure that Thunderbird continues to improve, as it has for the last ten years, active contributors recently organized to focus on the future.
Richin nijikib'äx chi junelïk tutz'ïr ri Thunderbird, achi'el rub'anon pe re ruk'isib'äl lajuj juna', ri samajel taq to'onela' k'a ri tikimöl ki' richin nikitzub'ej apo ri chwa'q kab'ij.

When quitting Thunderbird, visible tabs will be saved and will be restored when you open Thunderbird the next time. There is also a Tab menu on the Tab toolbar to help you switch between Tabs.

Toq xkatel pa Thumderbird, xkeyak kan ri tz'etel taq ruwi', chuqa' xkechojmirisäx chik toq xtajäq chik ri Thunderbird. Chuqa' k'o ruk'utsamaj ruwi' pa ri kikajtz'ik taq kisamajib'al taq ruwi', ri nuya' q'ij chawe ye'ajalwachij chi kikojol ri taq ruwi'.

With Personas, lightweight "skins" allow you to change the look and feel of Thunderbird in an instant. Hundreds of skins are available from the latest movies, famous landmarks, and Japanese tattoos. You can also choose from several Themes that dress up all the different icons in Thunderbird.

Rik'in Winaqi', aninäq "skins" nikiya' q'ij chawe najalwachij rutzub'al Thunderbird aninäq. K'ïy taq skin kichin k'ak'a' taq silowachib'äl, nimaläj taq ruk'ojlib'al retalil, chuqa' aj Japon taq ruwachib'al ch'akul ewachel. Chuqa' yatikïr nacha' chi kikojol k'ïy taq wachinel ri jalajöj yeq'alajin konojel ri taq ruwachib'al Thunderbird.

You might already know that Thunderbird improvements are no longer paid for by Mozilla. Fortunately there is an active community keeping it running and developing it further. But to survive long term, the project needs funding.
